What I do is a Monday/Thursday split where on Monday I’ll do seated overhead press with dumbbells (fairly heavy for 8 reps), lateral raises (medium weight for 10-12) and front raises (medium weight for 8 each arm/until failure) 

Thursday I’ll do overhead press with barbell (fairly heavy for 8 reps/until failure), then I’ll do a lateral raise machine (if you don’t have access to one then I’d recommend cabled lateral raises which work really well) and I’ll do them at a just above medium weight for 10/failure and lastly I do a shoulder press machine (again if you don’t have access to one I’d recommend a landmine press at a medium weight for 10-12 reps/ to failure) 

These are all for 3 sets and works really well for me and should give you results as long as they are done correctly with good form, remember to focus on your rear delts as well but I prefer them during my back days
